references.phrase: antiderivative F of f on I

references.context: Set of functions x↦F(x)+C for all real constants C, each on the same interval I.
Constant real-valued function on I, whose derivative is zero.

references.phrase: symbol indefinite integral does not denote a single number
references.disposition: It denotes a family of functions, not a definite integral over an interval.

review_rationale: Read indefinite integral as family of all constant shifts of an antiderivative on the same interval, distinct from a Riemann or Lebesgue definite integral.
